description: Returns the latest ~200 PvP battle records that involve {username}, either as attacker (username === {username}) or as victim (attacked === {username}). Sorted newest first by timestamp.

BattleLog.scrap: number — SCRAP transferred to the attacker (0 on dodge / cooldown)
BattleLog.seed: string? — RNG seed of the form '<blockHashA>@<blockHashB>@<timestampMs>' (absent when reason='cooldown')
BattleLog.dodged: boolean? — true when the defender dodged; false when the attack was blocked for another reason; omitted on a successful hit
BattleLog.reason: string? — 'dodge' when dodged=true, 'cooldown' when the target was still on cooldown; omitted on a successful hit

recordKinds.hit: dodged is absent and reason is absent — scrap > 0 transferred from attacked to username
recordKinds.dodge: dodged === true and reason === 'dodge' — scrap = 0, seed present, roll recorded
recordKinds.cooldown: dodged === false and reason === 'cooldown' — scrap = 0, no seed, no roll of significance
